title: rkload Configuration (v2)
description: Configuration file for rkload, schema version 2. A strict superset of v1: it keeps the method-keyed endpoint arrays and adds a top-level "scenarios" array of ordered, stateful request chains (extract a value from one step's response, inject it as ${var} into a later step). Configs MUST pin a versioned $schema URL (schemas/v2/...) — this file is immutable once published; future schema changes ship as schemas/v3/...

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema. Including this field enables autocomplete and validation in editors like VS Code.

version.description: Config schema version. Must be 2 for this schema, and MUST match the version segment of the $schema URL (e.g. .../schemas/v2/...). The runtime cross-checks both and rejects mismatches.

endpoints.description: List of endpoints to load test under this HTTP method. May be empty.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: A single HTTP endpoint to load test.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this endpoint, used in reports.

url.description: Target URL. Must include scheme (http:// or https://).

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with each request. All values must be strings.

body.description: Request body sent verbatim. For JSON payloads, supply a JSON-encoded string. Empty string means no body.

c.description: Number of concurrent workers for this endpoint.

requests.description: Total number of requests to send to this endpoint.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout as a Go duration string (e.g. "500ms", "30s", "1m30s", "1.5h").

scenarios.description: List of ordered request chains. Each scenario is run by its own pool of virtual users. May be empty.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: An ordered chain of HTTP steps executed in sequence by each virtual user, carrying variable state across the chain.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this scenario, used in reports.

vus.description: Number of concurrent virtual users running the chain (mirrors an endpoint's "c").

iterations.description: Total number of chain runs, distributed across the virtual users (mirrors "requests").

timeout.description: Per-request timeout applied to every step, as a Go duration string.

steps.description: The ordered steps of the chain. At least one is required.

step.title: Step
step.description: A single request in a scenario chain.

name.description: Optional label for this step, used in reports.

url.description: Target URL. May contain ${var} placeholders resolved from extracted variables or the environment.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with this step. Values may contain ${var} placeholders.

body.description: Request body sent verbatim. May contain ${var} placeholders.

extract.description: Rules that bind values from this step's response to variables usable as ${var} in later steps.

assert.description: Checks against this step's response. A failed assertion marks the step failed and aborts the rest of that chain iteration.

extractRule.title: Extract rule
extractRule.description: Pulls a value out of a step's response and binds it to a variable.

var.description: Variable name to bind. Referenced as ${var} in later steps.

from.description: Where to read the value from.

path.description: from=json: dotted path into the JSON body, e.g. data.items.0.id.

pattern.description: from=regex: pattern applied to the body; the first capture group is bound.

type.description: The kind of check to perform.

value.description: type=body-contains: substring the body must contain. type=json-equals: expected value at the given path (compared as a string).

path.description: type=json-equals: dotted JSON path to compare.

auth.title: Auth
auth.description: How to authenticate a scenario's requests. Applied to every step unless a step overrides it. Values may contain ${var} placeholders (e.g. ${API_TOKEN} from the environment). The oauth2 type is reserved in this schema but not yet executed by the runtime.

token.description: bearer / apikey: the token or key value.

header.description: apikey: the header name to set (defaults to Authorization).
